reviews.author: FluksFactory
reviews.text: Yus is a great teacher and great guy! Great hospitality, really made us feel like locals with some of his friends, drank coffee and just chat about the island. Recommend it to anyone who wants to try surfing! The next day I have also went fishing which ended up with a lunch with him and his brother, great experience aswell!

reviews.author: Ben Sweeney
reviews.text: Absolute Highlight of Our Trip!We had an amazing time during our first-ever surfing lesson with Dino and his team at Izzy School of Surf. From the moment we arrived, they were incredibly friendly, welcoming, and reassuring for beginners like us.The instructors gave excellent guidance, and thanks to their patience and helpful tips, we all managed to stand up on our boards! It was so much fun and an unforgettable experience.On top of the fantastic coaching, the lesson was very reasonably priced. If you are looking to learn how to surf in Lombok, we highly recommend Dino and his crew.

reviews.author: Clara Literski
reviews.text: I had a first lesson with Yus and it was the best choice ever! He is very friendly, gives detailed explanations but the best part comes along the good energy supporting you inside the water to catch the waves..made me feel super confident and capable to do it better each time. I came out of the sea wanting more, so that’s a good sign! Totally recommended as a beginner 🙂 thanks Yus!

reviews.author: Dominika Gorejová
reviews.text: Incredible surf lessons! A huge thanks to our instructor Yus for such an amazing experience. He was patient, professional, and very relaxed. You can tell he really wants his students to actually learn and enjoy every wave. We felt safe and comfortable the whole time. Can't wait to surf with him again in Lombok!

reviews.author: Ed Griffiths
reviews.text: I had an incredible private surf lesson with Yus! He’s such a friendly guy, and his positive vibes are infectious. He taught me the fundamentals of positioning and standing on the board whilst on the beach, and then guided me every step of the way whilst we were in the water. He’s very encouraging, giving you pointers to help you get better. By the end I was catching and riding the waves all the way to the beach 🤙 🏄‍♂️ For anyone staying in Lombok who wants to learn how to surf, Yus in your guy! Thanks brother 🙏
